Module net.automatalib.api
Package net.automatalib.automaton.vpa

Interface SEVPA<L,I>

All Superinterfaces:

public interface SEVPA<L,I> extends UniversalAutomaton<L,I,L,Boolean,Void>, InitialState<L>, DeterministicSemantics, SuffixOutput<I,Boolean>, GraphViewable, InputAlphabetHolder<I>
Interface for k-SEVPAs (k-module single entry visibly push-down automata), a visibly push-down automaton of specific structure and semantics. Additionally -- unless specified other by an implementation -- this interface only accepts well-matched words.

For more information on the semantics of VPAs see e.g. Congruences for Visibly Pushdown Languages by Alur, Kumar, Madhusudan and Viswanathan.

Note that this formalism integrates into the hierarchy of a non-deterministic UniversalAutomaton because a single return symbol may identify multiple transitions depending on the current top-of-stack symbol. Via getInternalSuccessor(Object, Object) and getReturnSuccessor(Object, Object, int), these information can be accessed deterministically. As a result, its states act more like locations than actual states. A (deterministic, infinite-state) semantics view can be obtained via the getSemantics() method.

For convenience, this type also implements SuffixOutput which delegates computation directly to its semantics.
